piece_package: 42 original Cat/Witch 20x20x8 mm flats and the supplied 8 mm V23 flat capstones; old sculpted/weighted packages unqualified
limitations: Motion and containment use rigid sampled poses, not a continuous or drop simulation.
Open trays remain upright during removal/repacking; they do not clamp pieces against inversion.
1.2 mm floors, actual grasp, full-tray warp/flex, release, closed shake/drop/carry retention and hinge fatigue require physical observation.
